notes.title: The Zen Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42185272/586ed27b1c7c8c3ca6dd699480b39c0cb4ad9518.png[/img]

Hello Incrementalists, 

For v1.1, a new experience has been added to the final level of Increment, the "breathing orb"! Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth on a gently guided meditation with the soothing sounds and pulsing colors of the breathing orb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42185272/09bb509415260b44d665a67fd383f69a000eab16.png[/img]

If you've already completed Increment, you should be able to load directly into the final area of the game and get right into the soul-soothing, breathing action via an auto-save in Slot 1 in the hand menu!
